title: Booze Cruise
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael organizes a mandatory booze cruise on Lake Wallenpaupack as a leadership training exercise, leading to various conflicts and events among the office staff. Dwight confronts Jim and Pam about his personal items being placed in the vending machine. Onboard, Michael clashes with Captain Jack over leadership roles while the employees engage in party activities. Roy publicly proposes to Pam, and Jim breaks up with Katy after relationship doubts. The episode culminates in Michael causing a panic by falsely announcing the ship is sinking, resulting in him being put in the brig.
